messages:
Marta: FYI escalation from NovaTech 19. Wire pay_0a1b2c returned by beneficiary bank this morning. Return reason: 'invalid correspondent / SWIFT unrecognized'. Return doc: https://files.redwood.internal/returns/pay_0a1b2c_mt103.pdf
Jess: Can you paste the original send payload and any MT103/trace we got from the provider? Need to see which correspondent was used.
Marta: Provider send payload (excerpt):
POST /v1/wires { payment_id: "pay_0a1b2c", amount: 1250000, currency: "USD", beneficiary_name: "NovaTech LLC", beneficiary_account: "GB29NWBK60161331926819", beneficiary_bank_swift: "NWBKGB2L", correspondent_bank_swift: "INTLUS33XXX", remittance: "Invoice 889" } response: 200 OK, settlement_trace: XRAY-20260312-9987
Leo: Provider's MT103 shows 57A Account With Institution = INTLUS33XXX. Receiving bank flagged 57A as invalid. Sounds like a correspondent mismatch — their UK bank expects a different USD correspondent.
Jess: Do we have beneficiary-specified correspondent on file? Some UK banks require a specific intermediary for USD clears.
Marta: Customer says their bank returned it and annotated '57A invalid'. They provided a preferred intermediary: BARCLAYSGB22.
Rick: @payments-bot please pull full SWIFT message and tell us if provider auto-inserted INTLUSUS33XXX or if it came from our request.
payments-bot: Full swift message retrieved. Provider mapping rule applied: map_correspondent_v3. Rule: if beneficiary_bank_country != sender_country and no explicit correspondent provided, insert INTLUS33XXX as default correspondent. (rule_id: map_correspondent_v3)
Jess: That mapping is likely root cause. We routed via INTLUS33XXX; beneficiary bank rejects that for USD.
Sam: Remediation plan: 1) Confirm return trace XRAY-20260312-9987 and attach MT103 to ticket. 2) Finance to process reversal/refund of 1,250,000 cents (USD 12,500.00) per reconciliation policy. 3) Offer to re-issue wire using BARCLAYSGB22 and include original trace in remittance. 4) If customer wants immediate resend, bill re-issue fee to card on file.
Marta: Draft message to customer: "We see a correspondent SWIFT mismatch caused by provider default routing. Please confirm acceptance of BARCLAYSGB22 for USD clearing and provide the MT103 return from your bank. Once received, we'll process refund and re-issue as requested." Send?
Leo: Legal asks we retain the MT103 before refunding so we have bank-level evidence for reconciliation. Hold on refund until MT103 is in records.
Marta: Sent to NovaTech.
NovaTech Rep: Sending MT103 now. Bank's note: 'use BARCLAYSGB22 for USD clearing; 57A invalid'. They confirm BARCLAYSGB22 is acceptable.
Jess: OK. Tasks: Finance (@Emma) to handle refund once MT103 is logged. Support to queue re-issue after refund unless customer authorizes immediate resend (owner: Marta). Billing to charge re-issue fee if customer requests immediate resend (owner: Jess).
Emma: Processing refund request, will update when completed.
Sam: Action: Create KB entry capturing this provider behavior: when map_correspondent_v3 applied, flag cross-border USD->GBP flows for manual review. Add watchlist alert.
Marta: Added tags to ticket: return_reason: correspondent_mismatch, provider_rule: map_correspondent_v3. Moving ticket to pending-finance.
Jess: Thanks everyone. Will follow up when refund cleared and resend confirmed. :white_check_mark:
